title: Shape the contract around the client intent
description: Select a workflow and the promises it exposes. The workbench compares the resulting route, completion signal, response bound, and client recovery against that workload.

workloads.label: Read one order
workloads.detail: Fetch one stable representation by order ID without changing business state.

workloads.label: Search recent orders
workloads.detail: Return a filtered, mutable collection with stable continuation behavior.

workloads.label: Create one payment
workloads.detail: Create a money-moving resource whose retries must preserve one client intent.

workloads.label: Export one year of orders
workloads.detail: Start work that exceeds an interactive request deadline and produces a later artifact.

shapes.label: Domain resource
shapes.detail: Expose stable nouns and use the HTTP method to express the operation.

shapes.label: Named action
shapes.detail: Expose a domain command under a resource when CRUD cannot express the transition.

shapes.label: Generic execute endpoint
shapes.detail: Send an operation name and arbitrary payload to one endpoint, hiding resource semantics.

completions.label: Return the completed result
completions.detail: Success means the documented state is already true when the response arrives.

completions.label: Accept a tracked operation
completions.detail: Return 202 and a durable status resource for work that completes later.

completions.label: Acknowledge without status
completions.detail: Return no operation identity, leaving the client unable to observe completion or failure.

pagination.label: Opaque cursor with a hard cap
pagination.detail: Bind continuation to a stable order and enforce a maximum page size.

pagination.label: Offset and limit
pagination.detail: Simple for small stable data, but mutable pages can skip or repeat rows.

pagination.label: Return every match
pagination.detail: Request work, payload, and latency grow with the entire stored collection.
